section.12: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

12.name_native: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Malik bin Al-Huwairith that:He saw the Prophet (ﷺ) raise his hands when he bowed, and when he raised his head from bowing, until they were in level with the highest part of his ears
